open_prs.body:
Long Studies save independent Use Motes intent and exact repeat-speed targets. Each new level starts at 1x and pays the full selected existing price again; actual Luminous reward boundaries determine payment timing.

R2 fixes QA blocker B1: a Motes boundary exposed double kill rounding in existing farm batching. Damage is decomposed before consuming partial enemy HP, with one coherent quotient/remainder carry. This also preserves small current HP against cancellation at very large damage. Prices, reward rules, save schema, navigation, workflows and existing numeric tolerances remain unchanged.

Final local validation: all seven workflow gates exit 0; all 140 default scenarios execute, 160 raw real browser/driver results independently replay as complete PASS, and all 12 required negative controls are caught. The aggregate suite console file lacks its tail; complete subprocess outputs and exits are preserved. The permanent B1 ledger covers all 826 QA fixtures with zero unjustified ON/OFF economy differences, rechecks all 43 R1 counterexamples, and rejects the exact old double-round function before undo passes. Additional evidence includes 100 QA motor groups, five persistence paths, 576 exact-rational arithmetic fixtures and 56 scaled whole/split thresholds. Earlier local drafts and interrupted validation are diagnostic evidence, not acceptance.

name: Build Android APK
# Verification trigger after P1-06 merge; workflow behavior unchanged.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'index.html'
      - 'branding/**'
      - 'fonts/**'
      - 'mobile/**'
      - 'scripts/verify_apk_identity.py'
      - '.github/workflows/build-android.yml'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

concurrency:
  group: lumenfall-android-main
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: mobile/package-lock.json

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Verify Android SDK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
          test -n "$ANDROID_HOME"
          test -d "$ANDROID_HOME"

      - name: Restore and verify stable Android signing key
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EXPECTED_SIGNING_SHA256: "A9:1C:BF:34:27:D2:CE:B1:CD:BE:07:E5:22:5F:17:D4:71:B1:82:9E:52:F7:AB:66:49:7E:75:49:75:AD:3E:21"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SIGNING_TAG="lumenfall-signing-v1"
          KEYSTORE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumenfall-signing"
          KEYSTORE_FILE="$KEYSTORE_DIR/Lumenfall-debug.keystore"
          KEYTOOL_OUTPUT="$KEYSTORE_DIR/keytool-output.txt"

          mkdir -p "$KEYSTORE_DIR" "$HOME/.android"

          if ! gh release view "$SIGNING_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::Established Android signing release '$SIGNING_TAG' is missing or inaccessible. Refusing to generate replacement signing material."
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! gh release download "$SIGNING_TAG" \
            --pattern "Lumenfall-debug.keystore" \
            --dir "$KEYSTORE_DIR" \
            --clobber; then
            echo "::error::Established Android signing keystore could not be downloaded. Refusing to build or publish."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -s "$KEYSTORE_FILE" ]; then
            echo "::error::Established Android signing keystore is missing or empty. Refusing to build or publish."
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! keytool -list -v \
            -keystore "$KEYSTORE_FILE" \
            -storepass android \
            -alias androiddebugkey >"$KEYTOOL_OUTPUT" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::Established Android signing keystore is unreadable, corrupt, or invalid for the expected signing alias. Refusing to build or publish."
            exit 1
          fi

          ACTUAL_SIGNING_SHA256="$(awk -F'SHA256: ' '/SHA256:/{print $2; exit}' "$KEYTOOL_OUTPUT" | tr -d '\r')"
          rm -f "$KEYTOOL_OUTPUT"

          if [ -z "$ACTUAL_SIGNING_SHA256" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not determine the Android signing certificate fingerprint. Refusing to build or publish."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$ACTUAL_SIGNING_SHA256" != "$EXPECTED_SIGNING_SHA256" ]; then
            echo "::error::Android signing certificate mismatch. Expected $EXPECTED_SIGNING_SHA256 but restored $ACTUAL_SIGNING_SHA256. Refusing to build or publish."
            exit 1

name: Pre-merge validation

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: lumenfall-pre-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validation:
    name: Lumenfall pre-merge validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: APK identity verifier self-test
        run: python3 scripts/verify_apk_identity.py --self-test

      - name: Validate game source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys, tempfile, subprocess

          src = Path("index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

          required_ids = [
              "settings-btn", "settings-overlay", "startup-intro",
              "enemy-stage", "enemy-glyph", "rift-objective",
              "spirit-list", "roster-journey",
              "research-list", "study-list", "node-list", "ach-list",
              "daily-card", "rift-push-btn", "rift-farm-btn", "ascend-btn"
          ]

          all_ids = re.findall(r'\sid="([^"]+)"', src)
          duplicates = sorted({x for x in all_ids if all_ids.count(x) > 1})
          if duplicates:
              raise SystemExit(f"QA failed: duplicate HTML ids: {duplicates}")

          id_set = set(all_ids)
          for element_id in required_ids:
              count = all_ids.count(element_id)
              if count != 1:
                  raise SystemExit(f"QA failed: id={element_id!r} occurs {count} times")

          literal_id_refs = set(re.findall(r'document\.getElementById\([\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]\)', src))
          missing_refs = sorted(literal_id_refs - id_set)
          if missing_refs:
              raise SystemExit(f"QA failed: getElementById references missing from HTML: {missing_refs}")

          cache_match = re.search(r'function cacheEls\(\)\{(.*?)\n\}', src, flags=re.S)
          if not cache_match:
              raise SystemExit("QA failed: cacheEls() not found")
          cached_ids = set(re.findall(r"'([^']+)'", cache_match.group(1)))
          stale_cached_ids = sorted(cached_ids - id_set)
          if stale_cached_ids:
              raise SystemExit(f"QA failed: cacheEls references missing from HTML: {stale_cached_ids}")

          forbidden = [
              'data-tab="about"',
              'Lumenfall-Setup.exe',
              'serviceWorker.register',
              'manifest.webmanifest',
              'BOSS_REGEN_PER_SEC',
              'studio-splash',
              'Xarib Productions',
              'intro-overlay',
              'prismGain()',
              'offline-preview',
              'function renderOfflinePreview(',
              'function computeOfflinePreview(',
              'id="luminous-tag"',
              'Luminous — bonus Motes on defeat'
          ]
          for token in forbidden:
              if token in src:
                  raise SystemExit(f"QA failed: forbidden legacy token remains: {token}")

          scripts = re.findall(r'<script(?:\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</script>', src, flags=re.S)
          if not scripts:
              raise SystemExit("QA failed: no inline JavaScript found")

          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
              for i, code in enumerate(scripts, start=1):
                  p = Path(td) / f"script-{i}.js"
                  p.write_text(code, encoding="utf-8")
                  result = subprocess.run(["node", "--check", str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True)
                  if result.returncode != 0:
                      print(result.stdout)
                      print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
                      raise SystemExit(f"QA failed: inline script {i} has a syntax error")
